summary: Backend-only regression for phone-reveal fee/GST settings (Iteration 27). Wrote 16 pytest cases across 8 test classes covering: GET defaults, PUT happy path, partial updates (each field independently), boundary values (0 and 100), Pydantic validation (negative fee, >100 pct, negative pct → 422), no-fields body → 400, RBAC (regular user, unauthenticated, manager) all blocked correctly, cross-field isolation (updating payout_l1 / auto_approve_on_payment / registration_fee does not touch phone_reveal_* values), and explicit defaults-restore. ALL 16 tests PASSED (100%). Backend settings round-trip both new fields correctly, validation constraints (ge=0, le=100) enforced, generic $set partial-update preserves untouched fields, super_admin-only RBAC enforced on PUT, and global doc was restored to phone_reveal_fee=1.0 / phone_reveal_gst_pct=18.0 at the end of the run.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/admin/settings uses payload.dict() — fine on Pydantic v1 but emits DeprecationWarning on v2 (should be payload.model_dump(exclude_none=True)). Non-blocking for this change.
get_settings() merges DEFAULT_SETTINGS over the stored doc, so legacy settings docs missing phone_reveal_* automatically backfill to 1.0/18.0 — confirmed by GET-defaults test.

Phone-reveal validation bounds (ge=0 for fee, ge=0/le=100 for pct) are correct; consider also adding an upper sanity ceiling on phone_reveal_fee (e.g. le=10000) to prevent admin typos from setting absurd reveal prices — optional hardening, not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Created one ephemeral manager admin (TEST_mgr_<ts>@test.com) via POST /api/admin/admins for the manager-RBAC test. NOTE: teardown DELETE /api/admin/admins/<id> returned 404, so the test manager account remains in the DB (identifiable by TEST_mgr_ prefix). Possible cause: POST returns user obj whose `id` field doesn't match the DELETE route's expected key (could be a user-collection vs admin-collection ID mismatch). Non-blocking — flag for main agent to verify if /api/admin/admins/{id} DELETE expects a different identifier. Global settings doc was restored to phone_reveal_fee=1.0 / phone_reveal_gst_pct=18.0 / payout_l1=400.0 / auto_approve_on_payment=True / registration_fee=118.0 — verified post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration27_phone_reveal_settings.py is idempotent and self-cleaning (autouse module fixture restores defaults). Safe to re-run as regression on any future settings/admin change. It depends on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL + ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD in env and the activated regular user test_alice_73dc7f@test.com (test_credentials.md).
